name: upstream-pr-reconciliation-dedupe
description: Upstream PR reconciliation dedupes durable GitHub events on repository + event kind + node id + content digest (edits change the digest and become new facts); attention items dedupe through EventStore.addAttentionOnce on campaign + reason + canonical detail JSON, which stays stable across reordered polls and restarts (warren-323d)

name: campaign-controller-pr-intent-journaling
description: Campaign-controller PR intents (warren-fb4f): derive the cross-fork head from the succeeded warren_dispatch action's resultBranch, journal the rendered request digest under a deterministic action key pr-intent:<campaignId>:<workItemId> before emission, and refuse fail-closed via PrIntentRefusal invariants (policy_stale/policy_changed, head_equals_base, evidence_absent, protected_path incl. dir-prefix ambiguity, PR cap breaches). Golden fixture pins the exact request; no mutation transport exists.
